required_outcomes: Recognises the job is resolved with no cost: Ruben's own machine is fitted and working, and the old LG is gone, so no removal is booked and nothing is charged to the landlord or the tenant.
Records the outcome on R-6810 and closes it without payment, with Ruben's call as the tenant confirmation and a verified message to Henry as the landlord being informed.
Tells Henry the LG has been disposed of at no cost to him and that the new machine is Ruben's own, so the inventory is updated (LG removed; tenant-owned Bosch not part of the let).
acceptable_alternatives: Sending the inventory addendum to both parties and closing once it is sent, in the same run.
positive_behaviours: Confirms to Ruben by email that the machine is recorded as hers and the request is closed.
Uses the close mode for a job with no invoice (without payment), not a normal close needing an invoice.
red_flags: Books Eastmere Appliance Care to collect a machine that has already gone.
Leaves the job open awaiting a removal that is no longer needed.
prohibited_actions: Escalating a completed, no-cost job to a human.
critical_failures: Charges the landlord or the tenant a removal fee.
